_comment: Synthetic replay fixture for the P2 CDA/document channel read-only connector PoC (R26) and the PHI exit guard (R28). The narrative deliberately embeds syntactically valid but entirely fake identifiers (reused from tests/test-negative-leakage.mjs) so the exit-guard tokenization and blocking paths stay under continuous regression. No real patient data may ever enter this file.
